additional_concerns: The executable answers only whether an applicable paragraph 14 demonstration request has been made. TRUE does not establish fulfilment, SFC satisfaction, smart-contract assurance, or compliance with paragraphs 10–13; FALSE does not extinguish confirmation or substantive duties.

Paragraph 14 expressly conditions demonstration on request, while footnote 5 repeats confirmation and demonstration without repeating that condition. Reading the footnote as minimum content preserves the candidate's interpretation; an independent unconditional-demonstration reading remains unresolved.
The supplied facts do not establish provider scope or an actual SFC request. Both classifications remain external judgments; the Boolean validation supplies no legal or factual proof.

Footnote 2, the complete referenced paragraphs 10–13, and Appendix Parts A and B are not supplied. Their absence limits broader compliance assessment, without itself preventing the narrow request-occurrence calculation.

The two UT Code 6.8 excerpts concern maintaining the register and, in the longer excerpt, providing its location on request. That request is distinct from paragraph 14 demonstration. The intermediary paragraph 13 likewise retains responsibility despite outsourcing without establishing a paragraph 14 request.

No unsupported substantive permission or additional trigger restriction appears in the scoped expression. Its TRUE_IS_SATISFIED convention must remain tied to satisfaction of the request condition, not satisfaction of the underlying duty.
